How does ClearFeed handle ticket management within Slack?

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best ClearFeed alternatives in 2026?

The strongest ClearFeed alternatives are eesel AI for AI that plugs into the helpdesk you already run, Unthread and Thena for B2B support in shared Slack channels, Suptask for the cheapest per-seat Slack ticketing, and Ravenna for internal IT and HR. If you would rather the helpdesk stay the system of record, look at Jira Service Management, Zendesk or Freshservice. Our full roundup of AI for Slack support goes wider.

How much does ClearFeed cost? [...] Is there a free ClearFeed alternative?

Nothing in this category is meaningfully free at volume, but the entry points differ a lot. Freshdesk has a free plan, eesel AI gives you $50 of usage with no card, and Suptask starts at $15 per agent. Our roundup of free ticketing systems covers the genuinely no-cost options, and ticketing for small teams covers the cheap ones.

What is the best ClearFeed alternative for Microsoft Teams?

ClearFeed treats Teams as an inbound channel rather than a place agents work, so almost anything beats it here. Ravenna treats Teams as a first-class surface, Thena includes it on its Enterprise tier, and eesel AI answers in Teams the same way it does in Slack. See our guide to AI for Microsoft Teams support and our wider look at AI in Microsoft Teams. [...] ### Our take

Take JSM if the answer to "where does this ticket actually get resolved" is already Jira. Skip it if you are a small support team who wanted a Slack layer, because you will be buying an ITSM platform to get one. If you like the surface but not the platform, our Jira Service Management alternatives roundup covers the middle ground, and the best AI for JSM covers bolting AI on instead.

## 7. Zendesk

Best for: teams who want the helpdesk to be the system of record and Slack to be a window into it.

Zendesk is the opposite bet to ClearFeed. Instead of making Slack the workspace, it keeps the ticket in Zendesk and lets Slack notify and update. Plenty of ClearFeed's own customers run exactly this shape, using ClearFeed as the bridge.
